note: One cue sheet for picture and sound. lines: the voice script (say = what the voice reads, text = caption). tools/vo.mjs fills in dur and words. shots: where each shot cuts in (at a time, before a line, or before a spoken word). music.from: the shot where the music enters. hiss: tape hiss level, 0 for a clean track.

lines.text: This film is made in code.
Every frame is a function of time.
